captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a single-speed track bicycle crankset assembly. It features a central black cylindrical bottom bracket spindle with silver mounting flanges on both ends. Attached to the spindle are two light-grey forged crank arms oriented 180 degrees apart, with the right arm integrated with a large five-spoke chainring containing outer gear teeth. At the tip of each crank arm, a black rectangular flat pedal is mounted via a thin cylindrical pedal axle, completing the functional assembly.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a single-speed track crankset with a central bottom bracket. It should include a left and right forged crank arm, a large five-spoke chainring on the drive side, and flat rectangular pedals attached to the ends of each crank arm.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly starting with a bottom bracket spindle using a central cylinder. The left and right crank arms are modeled as custom extruded shapes that taper and connect two cylindrical hubs. The chainring is built by extruding a thin disc, arraying triangular cuts to form the outer gear teeth, and adding five rectangular spoke cutouts. Finally, the pedals are constructed using rectangular boxes attached to thin cylindrical axles, with revolute joints defined at the spindle-crank interfaces and the pedal-crank connections.
